speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the background. Given your history of outdoor activities and the location on your left dorsal hand, is the rash symmetrical or unilateral, and did it appear immediately after sun exposure? Also, have you noticed any scaling, blistering, or peeling of the skin?

text: My main symptom is The presence of a rough, scaly, sandpaper-like plaque on the left dorsal hand. I also have No tenderness, No pain.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT).
